reviewer_role: Director of a university oral history program and historian
scope: Quakertown historical framing, provenance, historical uncertainty, terminology, intended users, and usability.
feedback_summary: The reviewer found the historical framing accurate but too limited in contextual depth; found archival provenance clear; noted that historical uncertainty is broader than Arkive's provenance and link-confidence categories; found the intended user and use case unclear; found the phrase "reconstructed person" awkward; reported that the feedback page did not work for them; and recommended seeking additional digital-humanities feedback from Dr. Andrew Torget.
